_readme: Voice mapping for pilot story narration (generate_story_audio.py). Narration voice picked by Xia 2026-08 (v2 — the ENG-337 Buju child voice sounded wrong for story narration and was replaced after a live listen); storyteller_tale is slightly slower for a cozier pace. To try alternatives: `python scripts/generate_story_audio.py --audition <voice_id>…`, listen in story_definitions/preview/audio_auditions/, then swap voice_id per teller here and regenerate with --force.
